stage.name: Deep in Danger
stage.description:
Do not meet their gaze – that is, if you can even find their eyes.

<Danger Zone> Operators in the Danger Zone retreat at the end of the wave.

<Entitative Program> Available when retrying a wave that you have completed. Greatly strengthens your Operators for the wave.

Boss.name: The Endspeaker, Will of We Many

spawns.enemy: The Endspeaker, Will of We Many

enemyConfigurations.name: The Endspeaker, Will of We Many
The Endspeaker, Will of We Many

nourished_predator.name: Nourished Predator
nourished_predator.flavourText: A Sea Terror that has learned to hunt efficiently. They themselves do not appear to require nutrients, instead reserving them for their lower-level kin. Before they die, they turn themselves into one last food source.
abilities: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

nourished_slider.name: Nourished Slider
nourished_slider.flavourText: A Sea Terror that crawled onto the shore and has sated its hunger. Its appendages can cause protein denaturation.
abilities: Attacks inflict additional Nervous Impairment

nourished_runner.name: Nourished Runner
nourished_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs and has sated its hunger. It controls its body's movements using hydraulic pressure and possesses superior reflexes.

nourished_spewer.name: Nourished Spewer
nourished_spewer.flavourText: A Sea Terror that has largely lost control of its functions, spewing out its spore-like progeny at a rate that surpasses its physical capacity, causing it to wear itself out prematurely.
abilities: Can attack all targets located on Nethersea Brand
Attacks 3 enemies simultaneously

regressed_predator.name: Regressed Predator
regressed_predator.flavourText: A special individual among the Predators. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.
abilities: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

regressed_spewer.name: Regressed Spewer
regressed_spewer.flavourText: A special individual among the Spewers. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.
abilities: Can attack all targets located on Nethersea Brand
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Attacks 3 targets simultaneously

nourished_founder.name: Nourished Founder
nourished_founder.flavourText: A Sea Terror that generally only metamorphoses within an abundance of the nethersea brand. They can on exceptionally rare occasions be born from the remains of their multiple kin.
abilities: Spawns Nethersea Brand at its location when defeated
Gains increased RES

nourished_crawler.name: Nourished Crawler
nourished_crawler.flavourText: A Sea Terror imbued with impurities that has had its hunger sated. Such Sea Terrors are rarely seen nowadays, as they are gradually evolving to become more nimble.
abilities: Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, immediately deal a large amount of Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to nearby units

regressed_reefbreaker.name: Regressed Reefbreaker
regressed_reefbreaker.flavourText: A special individual among the Reefbreakers. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.
abilities: Gains Invisibility when on Nethersea Brand
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Gains increased ATK after successfully dealing damage, decaying quickly after it stops attacking

regressed_swarmcaller.name: Regressed Swarmcaller
regressed_swarmcaller.flavourText: A special individual among the Swarmcallers. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.
abilities: Continually inflicts Arts damage and Nervous Impairment in an area around it
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Has Status resistance and is immune to Slow

nourished_reefbreaker.name: Nourished Reefbreaker
nourished_reefbreaker.flavourText: A Sea Terror born from the nethersea brand, used to expel entities that pose a significant threat to its kin, or to completely destroy environments unsuitable for sustaining life. All civilizations on land fall under this category.
abilities: Gains Invisibility when on Nethersea Brand
Gains increased ATK for each time it deals damage, decaying quickly after it stops attacking
Deals increased damage to enemies blocking this unit

nourished_swarmcaller.name: Nourished Swarmcaller
nourished_swarmcaller.flavourText: A special and extremely-rare individual, boasting incredible destructive power and far-reaching transmission range. They are unable to be dealt with through conventional means, Inquisitors must be extra vigilant around them.
abilities: Continually inflicts Arts damage and Nervous Impairment in an area around it
Has Status resistance and is immune to Slow

the_first_to_talk.name: The First To Talk
the_first_to_talk.flavourText: The first beautiful living being to speak human language before civilized man. Seaborn.
abilities: [Corrosive Vacuoles] Periodically unleashes Vacuoles on the target and a unit in the four adjacent tiles with the lowest Nervous Impairment accumulation, dealing Physical damage and Nervous Impairment

sal_viento_bishop_quintus.name: Sal Viento Bishop Quintus
sal_viento_bishop_quintus.flavourText: A member of the Church of the Deep who snuck into disaster-ravaged Iberia. He changed the law of the land through his sincere beliefs, in pursuit of the perfect form, yet he was unable to fathom the will of the ocean. Then again, who could?
abilities: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
[Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to all allied units
[Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
[Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and Stun them
[Species Outbreak] Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle

the_endspeaker_will_of_we_many.name: The Endspeaker, Will of We Many
the_endspeaker_will_of_we_many.flavourText: The tiny Seaborn that haunted the mighty Stultifera, the blood of its parents once strewn across the ocean's waters. The revelation reaches not the ears of the children, their kind's destiny quietly continuing to flow.
abilities: When defeated, disappears for a short time before evolving into its next form
When evolving into its next form, gains the following effects in this order: Gains increased DEF/Gains increased Movement Speed/Gains increased ATK and Lifesteal

[Consume] Consumes the [Remains] of its Seaborn kin, gaining their corresponding [Directed Evolution] ability in the next evolutionary phase, while also instantly defeating any Operators near the Remains and preventing them from being redeployed for a period of time.
